# Keyword abilities

<!-- Generated by `rake docs` from the primitive registry. Do not edit. -->

## abilities_cant_be_activated

Its activated abilities, mana abilities included, can't be activated ("Activated abilities of artifacts can't be activated" is a static handing it out).

Rules: CR 602.5, CR 605.3a, CR 101.2

```json
{
  "keywords": [
    "abilities cant be activated"
  ]
}
```

## assigns_damage_by_toughness

## paradigm

As this instant or sorcery finishes resolving: if it's the first time a spell you control with its name has resolved this game, at the beginning of each of your precombat main phases for the rest of the game you create a copy of the card in exile and may cast it without paying its mana cost. Then the spell is exiled.

Rules: CR 702.192a, CR 707.12, CR 603.7, CR 608.2g

```json
  "keywords": [
    "paradigm"
  ]
}
```
